evidence.quote: Specify a value between 10 MB (minimum) and 7 EB (maximum).
You can create only one per-query control limit in a workgroup and it applies to each query that runs in it.
Edit the value for **Data scanned limit**.

claim: For the per-query data usage control of an Athena workgroup (only one per workgroup, applying to each query that runs in it), you edit the Data scanned limit and specify a value between 10 MB (minimum) and 7 EB (maximum).

qualifiers.scope: Data scanned limit of the per-query control limit of an Athena workgroup

note: d002 | adjudicate-35 moved from condition (not carried by the quote): One per-query control limit per workgroup; the default action is to cancel a query that exceeds the limit and this cannot be changed.
